Transport and Travel Services for Ellora Visitors

Most transport problems at Ellora come from assumptions: that a return vehicle will be waiting, that a fare includes waiting time, or that a map pin is the gate.

Google Maps ↗ ASI source listing ↗

Independent guide · Page reviewed 9 November 2026 · ASI listing consulted 2026-10-29

Kailasa Temple (Cave 16) is one monument within the UNESCO-listed Ellora Caves. Prices, opening status and routes are dated listings to re-check, not live confirmations.

  1. Kailasa Temple Verul
  2. Food & accommodation
  3. Transport and Travel Services for Ellora Visitors

Choose the arrangement, then confirm the terms

A private car or taxi offers the most control over timing; a bus or shared service may cost less but needs current schedule checks. This guide does not publish operator names, fares, bus numbers or timetables because none have been independently verified.

Whatever the mode, write down the outward route, the return route, the waiting arrangement, the meeting point and the total charge before departure.

  • Agree the actual gate as the pick-up point, not a UNESCO property coordinate.
  • Confirm whether the price includes waiting, parking and the return leg.
  • Check that the vehicle can wait until the end of the sunrise-to-sunset visiting window.
  • Keep the ASI weekly Tuesday closure in mind when booking.

Reviewed 9 November 2026. No operator, price or schedule is claimed as verified.

Guides and extras

Guiding, audio devices, special access, parking and internal shuttles are separate from admission to the Ellora Caves. Do not assume any is included in the ASI-listed ticket; see the guided tours and parking pages for the questions to ask.

A short pre-departure checklist

Confirm the ASI opening status and current admission categories, check official weather warnings if travelling in the monsoon, carry water and identification, and allow time for admission plus the walk inside the property. Keep the verified Kailasa Temple map link handy, but agree the real gate in person.

Frequently asked questions

Which taxi company do you recommend?

None is named here because no operator has been independently verified. Agree the route, waiting time and total charge directly before departure.

Are buses available from the city?

Current bus numbers and timetables are not verified here. Check locally on the day.

Is a guide included in the ticket?

Do not assume so. Admission to the Ellora Caves and guiding are separate arrangements; see the guided tours page.

Sources and review limits

Page reviewed 9 November 2026. The ASI Ellora Caves page was consulted 2026-10-29; that review is not an on-site inspection, and no clear page-update date was visible on the ASI listing. A Google Maps snapshot or a UNESCO property coordinate is not a verified entrance, ticket counter or accessibility survey.

  • Archaeological Survey of India: Ellora Caves — identity, historical attribution, listed opening hours and admission categories.
  • UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Ellora Caves — the 1983 inscription, the ensemble and its artistic significance.
  • ASI official ticket service — check the actual visit date, eligibility and current charge.
  • Google Maps: Kailasa Temple — dated manual snapshot, not site-collected reviews.

No business name, price, timetable, distance, star rating or review score is published here without verification. Temporary closures, conservation work and special orders may override any general listing.
